Historical reference: zlib 1.1.3

Upstream repository: https://github.com/madler/zlib.git
Pinned source commit: 14763ac7c6c03bca62c39e35c03cf5bfc7728802
Release identity: zlib 1.1.3 (the signed v1.1.3 tag resolves to this source commit)

The files in this directory are unmodified upstream source/header files retained
only to reproduce the exact SNES Station v0.23 WIP EE code-generation evidence
for the memory-buffer wrapper corridor. The target independently embeds the
"1.1.3" and "deflate 1.1.3 Copyright 1995-1998 Jean-loup Gailly" strings.

Retained files:
- compress.c
- uncompr.c
- zlib.h
- zconf.h

The zlib license/copyright notice is preserved verbatim in zlib.h.
